input.name: RMS Cloud
input.title: Aussie holiday park operators compromised by RMS Cloud third-party breach
sentences: "We are contacting you as a past guest to make you aware our third-party booking system provider, RMS Cloud, has confirmed a global incident," a spokesman for the NSW-based Reflections Holidays said in an email seen by Cyber Daily.
RMS Cloud – which is used by more than 6,000 holiday parks, hotels, and campgrounds around the world – began monitoring malicious activity in the last 24 hours.
The next day, RMS Cloud began issuing new credentials to its integration partners, as well as providing assistance to complete the process.

input.name: Sharp Motor Group
input.title: Exclusive: Sharp Motor Group confirms third-party cyber incident in wake of ransomware claims
sentences: The hackers listed the Sharp Motor Group in a 23 August leak post, and while the hackers have not shared the volume of data they allege to have stolen, they have published several documents and files as evidence of the hack.
"Sharp Motor Group is aware that our third-party IT provider has been involved in a cyber incident," a company spokesperson told Cyber Daily.

input.name: Northpay

sentences: Northpay said an attacker used stolen staff credentials to access its merchant dashboard for three days.
